mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when FEDFUNDS declines over the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 8.0% triggers expectations of labor market stabilization, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns negative despite UNRATE crossing below 8.0 in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: High demand (GDPC1) combined with low supply (INDPRO) signals overexpansion, leading to market overvaluation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 13000 and INDPRO < 105 in next month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns positive when GDPC1 > 13000 and INDPRO < 105 in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates signal higher interest rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns positive during a monetary tightening cycle regime.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) create positive sentiment, driving S&P 500 forward returns upward over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 129526 and UNRATE < 9.7 in next month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns negative despite both PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 220 signals rising inflation expectations, prompting central banks to raise rates and dampening equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns positive when CPIAUCSL crosses above 220 in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in labor market employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust economic activity, fostering positive investor sentiment and driving S&P 500 forward returns upward over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive when PAYEMS rises over the next month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high supply (INDPRO) and low demand (GDPC1) create market overvaluation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns positive during late-cycle expansion with high INDPRO and low GDPC1.
